module: Editor for 'sites' files (*.sites.json): locations, zones and parking spots (parkingSpots), with their tags. It opens the 'Sites: Locations and Zones Editor' window with a File menu (New, Load, Save, Save as, Sites in Manager) and a Tools menu (sort by name, spot numbering, naming by zone), and one tab per sub-editor (editor/sitesEditor/*). It creates the 'Edit Sites' edit mode. A map modder uses it to place locations and parking spots.
notes: Default files: current mission folder or /gameplay/sites/, name newSite.sites.json.

Tools menu: 'Enumerate Parking Spots' suffixes duplicate names with a counter (1 to 4 digits depending on the count); 'Parkingspot Names by Zone Containment' renames each spot with the name of the last zone that contains it (can be slow).
BUG: M.onExtensionLoaded = onExtensionLoaded references a local variable that is never defined, so M.onExtensionLoaded is nil.
Internal windows: Locations, Zones, Parking Spots, Location Tags, Zone Tags, Parking Spot Tags.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Exported field but always nil (local variable not defined in the file).

saveSites.desc: Serializes a sites object and writes it as JSON to the given path; updates sites.dir and sites.name and remembers the folder as the last path.

loadSites.desc: Loads a sites file via gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites, makes it current, passes it to all sub-editors and resets their selection.

returns.desc: The current sites (the old object if loading failed).

managerSites.desc: Draws the 'Sites in Manager...' submenu: list of the sites per level and those of /gameplay, with Refresh, and loads the chosen one.

show.desc: Clears the object selection, shows the tool window and activates the sitesEditMode edit mode.

allowGizmo.desc: Tells whether the active edit mode is 'Edit Sites' (hence whether gizmos and clicks are allowed).

returns.desc: true if Edit Sites mode is active.

getCurrentSites.desc: Returns the sites object being edited.

getCurrentLocation.desc: Returns the location selected in the Locations tab.

getCurrentZone.desc: Returns the zone selected in the Zones tab.

getCurrentParkingSpot.desc: Returns the parking spot selected in the Parking Spots tab.

selectZone.desc: Selects a zone in the Zones tab (used by the click in the world).

mode.desc: 'toggle' to toggle, nil to replace the selection.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame of the editor UI: draws the window, the menus, the tabs, updates the mouse info (camera ray) and draws the sites in debug.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: registers the window, the sitesEditMode edit mode, the menu entry (Gameplay group) and creates the six sub-editors.

onEditorToolWindowHide.desc: Hook: if the tool window is hidden, goes back to objectSelect mode.

onEditorToolWindowGotFocus.desc: Hook: if the tool window gains focus, activates the sitesEditMode edit mode.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook (Lua reload): returns {path = serialization of the current sites}.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook after a Lua reload: reinjects data.path into the current sites.
